toxin.description_en: Lobs venom bubbles that burst into toxic pools. Poison persists briefly after enemies leave; overlapping pools refresh the strongest poison.
toxin.description_zh: 抛出毒泡，破裂后留下毒区。离开毒区仍会短暂中毒，重叠毒区只刷新较强毒性。

boneblade.description_en: Throws a spinning bone blade that curves back to its living organ. Each target can be struck once outbound and once returning.
boneblade.description_zh: 掷出旋转骨刃，再沿弧线回到发射器官。去程和回程各可命中同一目标一次。

parasite.description_en: Eggs hatch into two short-lived larvae on impact. Larvae crawl to nearby targets and bite; each organ can sustain six larvae, up to twenty-four in total.
parasite.description_zh: 虫卵命中后孵出两只短命幼虫，爬向附近敌人撕咬。每个器官最多维持六只幼虫，全身最多二十四只。
